definitions.explanation: Physical or mental pain and distress.

examples.japanese: この{作業|さぎょう}は{苦痛|くつう}だ。

notes:
{苦痛|くつう} refers to significant physical or mental pain.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {苦痛|くつう}を{感|かん}じる (to feel pain)
- {苦痛|くつう}を{与|あた}える (to cause pain)
- {苦痛|くつう}に{耐|た}える (to endure suffering)
- {苦痛|くつう}から{逃|のが}れる (to escape from pain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {苦痛|くつう}: pain, suffering (strong, formal)
- {痛|いた}み: pain (physical, general)
- {苦|くる}しみ: suffering (emotional/physical)
- {辛|つら}さ: hardship, difficulty
